title: EgoJEPA: Beyond Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
authors: Meng Cao, Can Zhao, Jinjie Wei et al

tldr.zh: EgoJEPA 先以人手运动差条件下的未来视觉预测学出潜在动作，再用人类视频预训练联合预测视觉与动作的 WAM，最后通过机器人示范和本体适配器微调，直接生成机器人动作，减少跨本体迁移对人工几何重定向的依赖。
tldr.en: EgoJEPA learns latent actions through future-visual prediction conditioned on hand-motion differences, pretrains a WAM to jointly predict visual dynamics and latent actions from human videos, then fine-tunes it with robot demonstrations and embodiment-specific adapters to directly generate robot actions with less reliance on hand-crafted geometric retargeting.

evaluation_scope.zh: 阶段 1 仍需视频对齐的人手运动标注；阶段 2 冻结动作编码器，以联合流匹配训练视觉／动作 Transformer；阶段 3 固定视觉编码器，同时微调视频 Transformer、动作 Transformer 和输入／输出 MLP 适配器，加入三视角及本体状态，预测 32 步相对机器人动作。评测为 Sharpa 抓玩偶，Wuji 叠杯、拉拉链、拧瓶盖，Xense Tac UMI 夹爪折纸箱，动作维度分别为 56／52／14；每任务在域内、域外各评测 20 次。域外平均成功率 74%，重定向基线为 65%；仍需本体及任务对应的机器人示范，未验证每项任务都能跨三种本体执行，也不是零样本换手或 MPC 搜索控制。
evaluation_scope.en: Stage 1 still requires video-aligned human hand-motion annotations. Stage 2 freezes the action encoder and trains visual/action Transformers with joint flow matching. Stage 3 freezes the visual encoder but jointly tunes the video and action Transformers and input/output MLP adapters, adds three views and proprioception, and predicts 32-step relative robot actions. Tasks are plush-toy grasping with Sharpa, cup stacking/zipper manipulation/bottle opening with Wuji, and box folding with a Xense Tac UMI gripper; action dimensions are 56/52/14. Each task has 20 trials per in-/out-of-domain setting. Average out-of-domain success is 74% versus 65% for retargeting. Embodiment/task-specific robot demonstrations remain necessary; evaluation does not establish every task across all three embodiments, zero-shot hand transfer or MPC-based control.
